scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --banner:js='import { createRequire as __evCjsRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __evCjsRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=dist/ev.js && chmod +x dist/ev.js && pnpm run build:server && node scripts/install-global.mjs
scripts.build:server: esbuild ../server/src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:better-sqlite3 --banner:js='import { createRequire as __evCjsRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __evCjsRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=dist/server/server.mjs && node ../server/scripts/ship-native.mjs dist/server/node_modules
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:standalone && npm pack --pack-destination dist
